items.claim: A global interceptor logs every operation call.
items.fact: An OperationCallInterceptor runs only around built-in operations (create, update, delete, list...). Custom operations are not intercepted and must log explicitly. Without overriding getOperations the interceptor attaches to all built-in operations; overriding narrows it to a named set of built-in operations. Fixed in the blueprint by batch bp08b; the same correction is in interceptor-derived-statistics-calculation.

items.topic: CLI create EnumerationMember has no --ordinal flag
items.fact: --ordinal is not a valid flag; `--set ordinal=1` works. Creating the same member twice reports 'Named element LOW is not unique in its container' and 'Enum member numbers ... not unique'. Each create adds to the unsaved change list; the scratch model must be saved or discarded (`fix save` / `discard --force`).

items.topic: CLI DataMember defaults: create attributes, don't edit defaults
items.claim: Entity creation default members were modified instead of adding attributes.
items.fact: The CLI creates default members (DataMember, relation members, '+5 contained') when an entity is created. Add your attributes via create; editing the defaults gives a wrong model. Rebuild the scratch copy if you did it wrong.

items.topic: `judo server stop` loses unsaved scratch package
items.fact: The scratch model lost its `bp` package after a `server stop`; unsaved changes are lost. Save (`fix save`) before stopping the server, and re-verify afterwards. Also validate with `validate --strict` before saving and copying to fragments/<id>.model.

items.topic: kb_get only searches the first configured source
items.claim: kb_get returned '(not found: ...)' for openspec/.../judo-doc-problems.md, AGENTS.md and skills/.../format.md although kb_search finds them.
items.fact: The pi-dashboard-kb-extension kb_get (extension.ts:162-171) uses `cfg.resolvedSources[0]?.id` as root only. With `catalog` first in the config, only catalog-relative paths resolve. Operator decision: make `.` the only source. Search results then return repo-root paths (catalog/model-blueprints/...). The extension reads config once and caches it (getKb), so /reload is needed, plus one full re-index from one place (not from agents); locking the index under running agents is dangerous.
Operator: 'put . as only source!' Applied to .pi/dashboard/knowledge_base.json as sources=[{kind:filesystem, ref:'.', priority:0}]. Needs /reload and one full reindex.

kb_search re-indexes before every query, so rewritten text appears in search quickly, while the full index (sqlite .pi/dashboard/kb/index.db, FTS5 table chunks) is fine. The kb guard warns on source searches/CLI without a kb_search consult ('3 consecutive searches without consulting the knowledge base').

items.topic: Subagent timelines are in-memory only; session log is the only record, truncated by default
items.fact: pi-dashboard-subagents 0.7.0 uses SessionManager.inMemory; the Agent tool result with timeline is persisted only inside the parent session JSONL (~/.pi/agent/sessions/<cwd>/...jsonl). By default results are bounded (resultMaxChars, detailsMaxChars, entryFieldMaxChars; ~20,000 per agent, 2,000 per entry, with '[N timeline entries omitted]'). Config ~/.pi/agent/extensions/pi-dashboard-subagents/config.json: set those three to 0 to disable cuts; maxBackgroundPending (default 8; cap rejected with 'Background limit reached'), maxConcurrent (0-64), backgroundTimeoutSec (0=off, Agent.timeout_s overrides), allowBackground (needs /reload). Settings re-read per call. Operator-side setting applied: maxBackgroundPending 12, limits 0.

items.topic: Hung/long subagents, failure without final output
items.fact: Several judo-blueprint-author batch agents ended 'subagent produced no final output' (bp09, bp11, earlier bp04, bp07, bp08). Lesson: smaller batches of 3-4 ids (bp08a/b, bp09a/b) with 'finish ONE id completely before the next' succeed more often. AgentCancel on a finished id returns not_found. Final reports (DONE/FAILED/KB/PROBLEMS) are cut in AgentStatus output when long.

items.topic: Run blueprint batches in slots; commit per batch only after lint+fragment check
items.fact: Per-id gate before commit: skills/judo-blueprint-author/scripts/entry-lint <dir> passes, no `format: legacy` in BLUEPRINT.md, and if fragments/<id>.model exists, skills/judo-model-mermaid/scripts/check <id> passes. Backend/frontend-only blueprints use `fragment: none: <reason>` (e.g. frontend-only). Fragment models are built in a scratch copy under /tmp/passb/<batch> with validate --strict, then copied to fragments/<id>.model; model.md starts with `## Model shape`.
